child_list.content: Get a Haircut
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
Mom: Louis, your hair is getting too long. It’s time for

a haircut.

Louis: Mom, I don’t want to cut my hair.

Mom: But it’s getting too messy.

Louis: Will it hurt, Mom?

Mom: Not at all. And it will be quick.

Louis: Can I choose the hairstyle?

Mom: Of course. You can decide it yourself.

Louis: That’s great! I want a cool hairstyle like a

superhero!

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

发了。

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
